description: This file contains test functions for the Kubernetes pod security admission policy, specifically testing the registry evaluation logic with various check configurations and version scenarios.

methods.name: TestCheckRegistry
methods.description: Tests the registry evaluation with various check configurations and version scenarios.

methods.name: TestCheckRegistry_NoBaseline
methods.description: Tests registry evaluation when no baseline checks are defined.

methods.name: TestCheckRegistry_NoRestricted
methods.description: Tests registry evaluation when no restricted checks are defined.

methods.name: TestCheckRegistry_Empty
methods.description: Tests registry evaluation with no checks defined.

methods.name: registryTestCase.Run
methods.description: Runs a specific test case for the registry evaluator, checking expected forbidden reasons for a given level and version.

methods.name: generateCheck
methods.description: Creates a Check object with specified ID, level, and versions, including a CheckPod function that returns a formatted forbidden reason.

methods.name: withOverrides
methods.description: Adds override check IDs to all versions of a Check object.

methods.name: versionOrPanic
methods.description: Parses a version string into an api.Version, panicking on error.
